excerpts.text:
Fix vacuity in mixture_confidence_sequence_uniformPrior; add nonzero witness

The headline anytime-valid theorem paired StronglyAdapted ℱ X (each X_k is
ℱ_k-strongly-measurable) with hcenter : μ[X_k | ℱ_k] = 0. For an integrable
ℱ_k-strongly-measurable function, condExp_of_stronglyMeasurable gives
μ[X_k | ℱ_k] = X_k, so the two hypotheses together force X_k =ᵐ 0. The only
admissible process was the zero process, and the old witness used exactly that,
so the headline was vacuous (for δ < 1 the crossing event is empty).

Fix: introduce IncrementAdapted ℱ X (each X_k is ℱ_(k+1)-strongly-measurable),
the standard martingale-difference indexing where the increment is revealed one
step ahead. Past-conditioned centering μ[X_k | ℱ_k] = 0 is then genuine, and the
running sum S_n stays ℱ_n-measurable since it uses only X_0..X_{n-1}. The
supermartingale step, the prefactor measurability, and the discharged
measurability/integrability package are all unchanged.

Blast radius: only mixture_confidence_sequence_uniformPrior combined increment
StronglyAdapted ℱ X with hcenter. Every other anytime-valid theorem and both
flagship assemblies hypothesize StronglyAdapted ℱ (subGammaExponentialProcess …),
the exponential-process adaptedness, which does not force X = 0; those are sound
and untouched.

Add examples/CheckAnytimeValidNonVacuityWitness.lean: a genuine ±1 Rademacher
sign increment on Bool with the ⊥-then-⊤ filtration, instantiating the corrected
headline to a real bound μ.real {…} ≤ 1/2. Axiom-clean
[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. Replace the old zero-process witness
note in CheckMixtureCS.lean with a pointer to the genuine one.

(cherry picked from commit 08a5d59868952503cf6486313658fbd940ad744b)

excerpts.text:
Fix vacuity in empirical-Bernstein CS; add nonzero witness

The headline empiricalBernstein_confidence_sequence_uniformPrior (and the
fixed-lambda empiricalBernstein_time_uniform_confidence_sequence) paired
present-conditioning StronglyAdapted on the increment X with
mu[X k | F k] = 0, which forces X =a.e. 0 by condExp_of_stronglyMeasurable
under a probability measure, leaving only the zero process admissible.

Switch the increment hypothesis to IncrementAdapted (X_k is F (k+1)-measurable)
while keeping the centering and conditional-variance on F k and keeping the
predictable variance proxy V on StronglyAdapted F V. Re-prove the two
foundation lemmas with the +1 shift (i < n implies i + 1 <= n).

Add a genuine non-vacuity witness instantiating the uniform-prior headline with
a +/-1 Rademacher increment (X 0 = +/-1, later increments zero), constant
variance proxy V = 1, b = 1, delta = 1/2, [lam0, lam1] = [1/2, 1], yielding the
concrete bound mu.real {omega | exists n > 0, 2 <= M_n omega} <= 1/2. Axioms:
propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound.
